shortDescription: Content loading, saving, 3D-to-screen projection and device helpers for HolyHolyHoly 3D.
description: Small JavaScript helpers used by the scenes: load the game content (JSON) into a global variable, keep the save in the browser storage (merged over the defaults, so new fields keep their default values), project a 3D position to a 2D layer, and read device preferences (touch screen, reduced motion).
